key_values.event_name: Storm Ciaran North Atlantic explosive cyclogenesis

ledger_formulae.gpm_max_mean_ratio: GPM event accumulated precipitation maximum / mean
ledger_formulae.nov2_share: 2 November point precipitation / event-total point precipitation
ledger_formulae.pressure_fall: max over hourly series of pressure(t-24h) - pressure(t)

key_values.required_rejected_alternative: A rainfall-first or single-peak-gust explanation is inconsistent with the local rainfall thresholds and the multi-hour gust impulse after minimum pressure.

primary_gt.conclusion: The ledger supports a rapid-deepening, wind-led Storm Ciaran diagnosis with rainfall as secondary local context.
primary_gt.rejected_alternative: A rainfall-first or single-peak-gust explanation fails because the local rainfall thresholds are not met and the gust signal persists after the pressure minimum.

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON object with all six top-level fields and all required nested fields.
criteria.name: Answer schema completeness
criteria.partial_credit: Allow minor naming or ordering differences that preserve the same values.

criteria.description: Computes 26.0 hPa maximum 24-hour pressure fall, 20.9 hPa threshold, 1.245 ratio, and pass true.
criteria.name: Rapid-deepening calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct pressure fall with incomplete threshold or ratio logic.

criteria.description: Reports 977.6 hPa minimum pressure, 83.2 km/h maximum gust, 4.0 h lag, 11 hours >=70 km/h, 4 hours >=80 km/h, impulse score 19, and pass true.
criteria.name: Wind-persistence calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct peak values with incomplete duration or impulse logic.

criteria.description: Reports 17.4 mm point total, 0.126 2 November share, 7.66 GPM max/mean ratio, and local_rain_dominant false.
criteria.name: Rainfall contrast calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct local precipitation or GPM ratio alone.

criteria.description: Concludes that the ledger supports a rapid-deepening, wind-led diagnosis with rainfall secondary in the local ledger.
criteria.name: Consistency conclusion
criteria.partial_credit: Interpretation wording may vary if it follows the pass/fail results.

criteria.description: Rejects rainfall-first and/or single-peak-gust interpretations using the computed thresholds.
criteria.name: Rejected alternative
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for generic storm description without computed support.

criteria.description: Avoids extra exact damage, outage, casualty, or impact-location claims not established by the ledger.
criteria.name: Answer discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Minor non-scored context is acceptable if the numeric answer remains central.
